claimed_changes: Return ApiResult<T> directly from application services
Simplify API controllers by delegating business codes to services
observed_changes: Controllers no longer construct ApiResult objects and instead return the service result directly. Service interfaces and implementations (Bet, Claim, Prediction, Round) now return ApiResult<T>, with the result-code setting logic moved into the services. Behavior is preserved: the same codes are set at the same failure points.
reason: The description accurately covers the change. The ApiResult wrapping logic moves from controllers into services and the signatures change to match, with no unmentioned logic changes. This is a move-method style refactoring of the result-wrapping responsibility.
